main.description: Declares an LLM model connection configured for the org. Lives in the org's `members` space, authored by the org DID. Holds only connection metadata: any API key for the provider is stored encrypted by pear, never in this record. name is restricted to a limited character set (letters, digits, dots, hyphens, underscores) since it also serves as this record's key and as the model ID the org's OpenAI-compatible API exposes the connection under.

name.description: Also this record's key, and the model ID clients request. Letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores only.

provider.description: The provider API pear calls the model through; see network.habitat.llm.defs#connection.

model.description: The provider's identifier for the model, e.g. gpt-4o or claude-sonnet-4-5.

baseUrl.description: The provider API's base URL, overriding the provider's default. Required for ollama. For openai, any OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. OpenRouter's https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).
